Leaves 6-12 x 2-4 cm, elliptic-lanceolate or oblong, obtuse-acute, truncate or subcordate at base, petiolate or subsessile, petiole 4-10 cm long. Ochreae 10-20 mm long, truncate, glabrous or rarely sparsely ciliate-hispid. Inflorescence densely flowered, conical, 8-30 mm long, solitary raceme. Ochreolae 1-2 x c. 1 mm, ovate. Flowers pedicellate. Tepals 5, biseriate, bright red or pink, 2-2.5 x 1.5-2 mm narrowly elliptic. Stamens 5, exerted. Ovary oval, 1.3-2 mm long, with inserted or exserted styles, styles 2, 2-4 mm long, free, stigma capitate. Nuts 2.5-3.3 x 1.5-2.0 mm, ovoid or orbicular, shining, dark brown, inserted or slightly exerted with the base of style forming a persistent beak.

Ascending-erect, 20-30 (-50) cm high, glabrous - glandular hairy, annual herb. Stem simple or branched with striate internodes. Leaves 1.8-5 x 0.5-3 cm, lower ones often ± rhomboid with a rotundate base, upper ones petiolate, cordate to amplexicaul with a auricled base, petiole 1 cm long, slightly to moderately winged. Ochrea tubular-truncate, glabrous - glandular or hairy at base 4-5 mm long, brownish. Inflorescence terminal corymbose head, head 6-7 mm in diameter, substanded by an involucral leaf. Involucral leaf sessile, subamplexicaul, ovate to lanceolate, 6.5-12.5 x 2.5-5 mm. Ochreolae 4-5 x 2-3 mm, ovate, acute. Flowers 2.0-2.5 (-3)  mm across shortly pedicellate. Tepals 4-5, obovate, obtuse, light pink-blue, 2.0-2.5 x 1.0-1.5 mm. Stamens 5-6, filaments short, fused at the base. Ovary biconvex or trigonous, with 2-3 unequal styles, styles united at base; stigma rounded or capitate. Nuts biconvex or trigonous, shining, 1.75-2.0 x 1.75-2.0 mm, black, enclosed within slightly accrescent ± papery perianth.

This species has been frequently recorded from Pakistan and other neighbouring countries. This perennial species which is characterized by weak stem, long ochreal setae and slender spikes most probably does not extend beyond Mediterranean region and Syrian desert. This is replaced in our region by Persicaria longiseta (an annual species) and P. barbata var. gracilis (a perennial species). Though var. gracilis is sometimes treated as conspecific with P. salicifolia by some workers, but we understand both are different entities. Besides the difference in geographical distribution the spikes are also different. It is compact in the var. gracilis but slender in P. salisifolia.

Undershrub, almost annually burnt down by forest fires; branches thinly pubescent. Leaf c. 2.5-6.5 cm long, petiole c. 1.2-1.3 cm long; leaflets 3-5-(11-13), c. 1.0-2.0 cm long, obovate, oblong, often emargintate, sparesly appressed pubescent on both surfaces; stipules minute caducous. Inflorescence a raceme, usually from woody branches, c. 20.0-30.0 cm long. Bract small caducous, shorter than pedicel. Calyx small, teeth triangular, smaller than cup. Corolla pale purple with darker lines, c. 8-9 mm long. Fruit c. 2.5-3.8 cm long straight, 9-12-seeded.

Undershrub, up to 1 mm tall, branches pubescent. Leaf trifoliolate. Petiole up to 4 mm long, leaflets 7-20 mm long, oblanceolate, linear-cuneate or linear-oblong, obtuse, truncate, mucronate; stipules c. 2.5-3.0 mm long, linear. Inflorescence 4-8-flowered umbel, peduncle 0-2.5 cm long. Bracts c. 4 mm long. Calyx c. 7.5-9.0 mm long, densely silky, teeth much longer than the tube. Corolla c. 1.2-1.3 cm long, pale yellow, keel tipped with purple. Fruit c. 2.5 mm long, grey-tomentose.

Biennial or perennial, 15-40 cm tall, erect, sometimes woody at base, rarely branched above, appressedly hairy with 2-3-partite hairs. Basal leaves ± rosulate, oblong-elliptic, 5-10 cm long, 5-12 mm broad, stalked, denticulate to subentire, acute; cauline leaves ± similar to the basal leaves, shortly stalked to sessile, becoming smaller above. Recemes 20-40-flowered, up to 15 cm long in fruit. Flowers c. 12 mm across, orange-yellow; pedicels 5-7 mm long in fruit, slightly thickened, spreading. Sepals 7-8 mm long. Petals 15-18 mm long, 4-5 mm broad. Stamens 7-9: 10-12 mm long; anthers c. 2.5 mm long. Siliquae linear-terete, 40-60 mm long, 1.5 mm broad, appressedly hairy ; valves with a distinct mid-rib; style 3-5 mm long with capitate, sub-bilobed stigma; seeds c. 1.7 mm long, oblong-ellipsoid, darkbrown.

Annual, 10-40 cm tall, erect, branched, glabrous, subglaucous, sometimes entire plant violaceous except the siliculae. Basal leaves withering soon, oblong-lanceolate, entire, amplexicaul, auricled at base; cauline leaves linear-lanceolate, 1-5 cm long, 3-10 mm broad, ± similar to basal leaves; all leaves often sparsely hairy at the apex with simple hairs. Racemes 15-30-flowered, up to 10 cm long in fruit, ebracteate. Flowers 3-4 mm across, yellow; pedicel 5-8 mm long in fruit, filiform, often deflexed. Sepals 1.5-2 mm long, c. 1 mm broad. Petals c. 4 mm long, 1.5 mm broad, oblong-obovate, cuneate below, apex subrounded. Stamens c. 2:2.5 mm long; anthers c. 0.5 mm. Siliculae broadly elliptic, 5-7 mm long, 3-5 mm broad, flattened; wing very narrow, uniform, ± ciliately hairy with simple, short hairs; locule glabrous or minutely hairy; seed c. 2.5 mm long, 1 mm broad, oblong-ellipsoid, brownish.

Annual, 4-12 cm long, erect or suberect, branched mostly from the base, clothed with soft, branched hairs. Leaves few, scattered, oblanceolate, 15-35 mm long, 3-7 mm broad, entire, apex obtuse or rounded. Racemes 12-20-flowered, up to 4 cm long in fruit. Flowers 2-2.5 mm across, yellow; pedicels up to c. 2 mm long in fruit, curved outwards, slightly thickened. Sepals c. 1.2 mm long. Petals 2-2.5 mm long, c. 1 mm broad, spathulate. Stamens c. 1:1.5 mm long. Siliquae 4-5 (-6) mm long, 1-1.5 mm broad, terete pubescent; horns c. 0.5 mm long, with somewhat blunt apices; stigma minute, almost sessile; seeds usually 2 in each locule, 1-1.5 mm long, oblong-ovate, pale brown.

Perennial, densely caespitose herbs; rootstock much branched, densely covered with withered leaves. Scapes up to 5 cm long in fruit, aphyllous. Basal leaves densely rosulate, oblong-spathulate, (2.5-) 4-6 (-10) mm long, 1-1.5 (-2) mm broad, obtuse, ± softly hairy, often densely so, with whitish, simple or branched hairs. Racemes 5-10-flowered, corymbose. Flowers c. 3.5 mm across, yellow; pedicels 3-5 mm long in fruit, spreading, glabrous. Sepals c. 2 mm long, 1 mm broad. Petals 3-3.5 mm long, c. 1.5 mm broad, apex obscurely emarginate. Stamens c. 2:2.5 mm long; anthers c. 0.4 mm long. Siliculae ovoid, 3-4 mm long, 2-2.5 mm broad, glabrous, acute, base ± rounded; style c. 0.5 mm long, with depressed capitate stigma; septum not veined; seeds 4-6 in each locule, c. 0.7 mm long, oblong-ovate, brown.

Annual or birennial, 20-50 (-75) cm tall, erect, sparsely branched above, villous to subglabrous with unequal hairs. Lower leaves 3-5 jugate, pinnatisect, stalked; lobes narrow, 0-2-lobulate; upper smaller, subsessile or sessile. Racemes 20-30 (-50)-flowered, up to 20 cm long in fruit. Flowers c. 3 mm across, yellow; pedicels 6-10 mm long in fruit, spreading or ascending, filiform. Sepals 1.5-2 mm long. Petals c. 3 mm long, 1 mm broad. Stamens c. 1.5: 2 mm long; anthers c. 0.5 mm long. Siliquae (6-) 8-10 mm long, 1-1.2 mm broad, subterete, glabrous; valves convex, 1-veined; style inconspicuous, c. 0.5 mm long with depressed, short stigma; septum not veined; seeds usually 3-4 in each locule, c. 1 (-1.5) mm long.

Perennial, 10-15 cm tall, sparsely hairy below with short, branched hairs; rootstock 2-3 mm thick, branched above; scapes simple, aphyllous (rarely 1 or 2 leaved). Radical leaves oblanceolate, 1.5-5 cm long, 2-6 mm broad, entire or slightly 1-3 (-5) toothed towards the apex, sparsely hairy; cauline leaves if present very short, linear, entire. Racemes 5-10-flowered, lax, up to 8 cm long in fruit. Flowers c. 5 mm across, white; pedicels 5(-7) mm long in fruit, ascending or sub-erect. Sepals 3-3.5 mm long. Petals 5-7 mm long, c. 1.5 mm broad, linear, cuneate. Stamens c. 3:3.5 mm long. Siliquae linear, strongly compressed, 2-3(-4) cm long, 1 (-1.5) mm broad, acute, straight, ± erect, glabrous; valve 1-veined; style 0.5-0.7 mm long with minute depressed stigma; seeds 12-16 in each locule, c. 1 mm long, not mucilaginouswhen wet.

Plantae c. 1 m altae, base fibrous, caule ramoso. Folia basalia, longe petio¬lata 4-pinnata c. 20 cm longa; segmenta ultima linearia I-4 cm longa atque coriacea acutaque; folia caulina pauca atque redacta. Umbellae compositae, radiis formantibus umbellas secundarias; involucri bracteae 5 parvae lineares; 6-10 radii secundarii 2-3 cm longi. Pedicelli floris 6-7 cm longi. Stylopodium complanatum; styli 2 mm longi. Fructus dorsaliter compressi oblongi, 5 mm lon¬gi, 3 mm lati; costae aequaliter alatae, base latae; vittae circum seminem numerosae, minutae, in costis alatis paucae.

Plants c. 1 m tall, base fibrous. Stem branched. Leaves mostly radical, long petioled, 4-pinnate, c. 20 cm long; ultimate segments linear, I-4 mm long. coriaceous, stiff, acute; cauline leaves few, reduced. Umbels terminal and axillary. Rays with secondary umbels; secondary rays 6-10, 2-3 cm long. Involucre of 5 small linear bracts, deciduous. Bractlets similar to the bracts. Flower pedicels 6-7 mm long. Calyx teeth minute. Stylopodium flattened; styles 2 mm long, divaricate. Fruit dorsally compressed, oblong, 5 mm long, 3 mm broad; ridges equally winged, broad at the base; vittae minute, numerous around the seed, a few in the ridges. Inner seed face plane.

Evergreen shrubs upto 2 m tall. Stem glabrous, younger shoots tomen¬tose. Leaves scattered, elliptic-oblong to lanceolate, 6-14 cm long, 2-3 cm broad, glaucescent, coriaceous, subsessile. Flowers white, sessile, in terminal clusters of 4-9. Involucral bracts 5-7, ovate, c. 1.4 mm long, imbricate. Calyx tube c. 1 cm long, tubular, pubescent, 4-lobed; lobes c. 4 mm long, ovate, spreading. Stamens 8, 2-seriate, included, subsessile. Ovary ovoid to ellipsoid, 3.5 mm long, glabrous; style obscure, stigma capitate. Fruit c. 1 cm long, ovoid, dark red, succulent.

Perennial herb, up to 100 cm tall, glabrous. Leaves deltoid, angles acuminate, toothed, membranous, suddenly contracted into a broad, short cuneate petiole, 10-15 (-20) cm across the angles. Capitula arranged in long peduncled axillary or terminal second panicled racemes, sessile or peduncled and drooping, 1.0-1.5 cm in diameter, florets 3 times as long as the phyllaries. Phyllaries 5, narrow-linear, acute, 5-6 mm long, glabrous. Anthers long exserted, tailed. Cypselas oblong, 5-5.5 mm long, glabrous. Pappus 6-7 mm long, white.

Perennial herb, white hairy. Leaves elliptic-oblong, lyrate to sublyrate, pinnatifid or subspathulate, usually with a large, elliptic-oblong terminal lobe and 1-4 pairs of smaller irregular or sinuate-rounded lateral lobes, green and glabrous or sparsely pilose above, softly greyish, felted tomentose beneath, nerves indistinct, apex acute-mucronate, 6-15 x 3-7 cm, base cuneate or decurrent into a wing, margin remotely and indistinctly crenate. Scapes light brownish floccose, bracteate. Capitula heterogamous, radiate, 3-4 cm across. Involucral bracts lanceolate or linear, multiseriate, imbricate, outer one small, inner 10-15 mm long. Ray florets female, white, pink or white tinged with pink, bilabiate, tube  straight. Disc florets bisexual, similar to ray florets in colour, tube  straight. Cypsela 5-7 mm long, 5-9-ribbed, pilose or glabrous. Pappus barbellate, 2-seriate, whitish.
Differs from the type variety in having more lanceolate, less coriaceous leaves with long acumen and shortly 4-toothed calyx and smaller, globose less fleshy berries.

Up to 120 cm tall, stout herb. Stem finely pubescent, terete often flexuous, branched, naked below. Leaves membranous, 7-12 cm long, usually as broad as long, triangular-cordate or obscurely 3-lobed, acuminate irregularly sinuate toothed angles and teeth apiculate, petiole slender, base, broadly auricled. Racemes very slender, panicled. Capitula c. 6 mm long, very shortly peduncled, drooping. Phyllaries 3-5, c. 2.5 mm long, oblong, much smaller than the corollas. Corolla c. 5.5 mm long. Anthers slightly exserted. Cypselas glabrous, ribbed, c. 2 mm long, shorter than the copious brown or reddish pappus.

Perennial scapose herb. Leaves elliptic-oblong, apex rounded-tapering, base cordate, entire-subsinuate, glabrous above, tomentose beneath. Scapes erbracteate. Capitula heterogamous radiate. Involucral bracts lanceolate, long tapering, tomentose-pilose, upper ones with dark central part and reddish-blackish margins, subglandular hairy. Ray florets female. Disc florets tubular, bisexual, 5-toothed. Cypselas 5-9 mm long, 7-11-ribbed, villous. Pappus bristles whitish, apically ± violet-reddish tinged.
